# tplinkeasysmart_storm_control (Data Source)

Per-port storm control (QoS > Storm Control). Read-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tplinkeasysmart_storm_control" "this" {}

output "storm_enabled_ports" {
  value = [for p in data.tplinkeasysmart_storm_control.this.ports : p.port if p.enabled]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `switch` (String) Name of the switch (a key of the provider's `switches` map) this object lives on. Omit it to use the provider's own switch (`host`), or the only configured switch.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `storm_control`.
- `ports` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports))

<a id="nestedatt--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports`

Read-Only:

- `broadcast` (Boolean) Limit broadcast traffic.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Storm control is active: a rate is set and at least one traffic type selected (as in the web UI).
- `multicast` (Boolean) Limit multicast traffic.
- `port` (Number) Port number.
- `rate_kbps` (Number) Rate limit in kbps; 0 = unlimited.
- `unknown_unicast` (Boolean) Limit unknown unicast traffic.
